metadata.task: Task 22: Operator-Matched Replay SFT with Parameter Isolation
metadata.generation_contract: Task 21B batching contract preserved verbatim: BOS-prefixed prompt, left padding, no attention mask passed to the model, max_new_tokens=256.
metadata.retention_probe_decoding: greedy (matches Task 20 baseline and Task 21B report)
metadata.generation_stop_rule: Generation halts on EOS or on the </answer> token (a single dedicated token id). Equation validity, strict accuracy and full-format compliance are byte-identical to running to 256 tokens, because all three read only the first <think>..</think> and the first <answer>..</answer>. Reported generation LENGTH and REPETITION are therefore measured up to and including </answer>, and are NOT comparable to the Task 21B report's length/repetition figures, which included post-answer continuation.

delta_replay_trainability._definition: Model F (replay, all trainable) minus Model E (replay, frozen). Isolates parameter freezing from replay data.

metadata.verdict: Conclusion D: Step-level equation validity regressed (-14.00 pts vs Task 21B Model A).

freezing_control_model_E.note: NOT a point on the ratio curve

gates.G3: EOS>=95 and full_format>=95 and p90<128 and greedy_repetition<90

task23.outcome: No arm passes all gates; G2 (PPL<=35) failed by every trainable arm including the 0% baseline (43.88).

selected_final_model.rule: protocol fallback: best existing trainable model by RCS when no arm passes

task23.confound: 0/10/25/50 is not a pure ratio curve: F's replay is 100% replay_arithmetic (no target-regime subtraction), while G/H replay is 50/50 replay_arithmetic + progressive_subtraction. Ratio and composition cannot be separated here.
conclusions: replay helps but language cost remains high
replay ratio is not the only lever - composition matters at least as much
